candidates.title: Daily sales by product (till system)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source of daily units and revenue per product code; catalog temporal coverage starts 2022-01-01 with no end date, refreshed daily (last 2026-10-14), so it spans both windows.
candidates.found_via: search 'Valdena daily sales by product'; get_catalog_entry; wiki till_migration_2024 and product_codes_2024 backlinks
suspected_issues: Wiki till_migration_2024 (2024-03-12): no rows between 2024-02-05 and 2024-03-10 because the till was replaced; these must be treated as missing, not zero
Wiki product_codes_2024 (2024-04-02): from 2024-04-01 codes ending in 'L' were replaced; no mapping table exists, only name matching, and some names are not unique
Catalog classification 'confidential'; access via warehouse SQL request to Retail Operations
Catalog does not state whether revenue/units are net of refunds and voids; revenue_eur currency documented as EUR
Wiki pages last edited 2024; may not reflect later changes

candidates.title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)

candidates.found_via: search 'shop opening hours closure days calendar'; get_catalog_entry

Refresh is weekly (last 2026-10-10); recent closures may be missing
event_name is free text; coverage of events unknown
Does not hold national holidays (N4 must come from the register)

Reanalysis (model-based), not station observation; may understate peak heat
Register default coordinates (38.72, -9.14) are a placeholder and are not Italian; do not use

unmet_needs: N2: No mapping table between pre- and post-2024 product codes exists (wiki product_codes_2024). Only name-based matching is possible and names are not unique. Retail Operations must confirm a mapping or list discontinued products; no register source can supply this.

N5 local events: no internal events source beyond free-text event_name in store.calendar. A human would need to supply a municipal events calendar for the chosen town, with licence stated (dataset link).
N3 location: shop city not named in any source. Owner must confirm coordinates before the Open-Meteo call; no internal source holds them.

N4 local holidays: Nager covers national holidays only; patron-saint day of the shop's town is not covered by any register source. A second reference for the Italian national list would need a link from the human.
Sales refund/void treatment and units vs value basis are undocumented in the catalog; needs owner confirmation from Retail Operations.
Station-based observed temperature (ARPA or similar) is not in the register; would need a human-supplied link if reanalysis is judged insufficient.
